name: phil/api-keys-bundle
description: Access tokens for a public Symfony API: hashed and shown once, scoped, expiring, revocable and rotated, checked by the access_token authenticator of Security.

suggest.phil/api-contract-bundle: To answer authentication failures with RFC 9457 problem details
suggest.phil/ip-anonymizer: To keep an anonymized form of the address a token was last used from
suggest.phil/rate-limit-bundle: For rate limits counted by token, with RateLimit headers
suggest.phil/url: For the endpoint of GitHub's secret scanning, which checks the address of GitHub's keys
suggest.phil/usage-meter-bundle: For quotas counted by token on meters, through phil/rate-limit-bundle
suggest.symfony/cache: For the endpoint of GitHub's secret scanning, which keeps GitHub's keys in a cache pool
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:api-keys:create, list, revoke and purge-expired
suggest.symfony/form: For the page where members create and revoke their tokens
suggest.symfony/http-client: For the endpoint of GitHub's secret scanning, which fetches GitHub's keys
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the page where members create and revoke their tokens
suggest.twig/twig: For the page where members create and revoke their tokens
